name: Blue Ridge Energy Propane & Fuels
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public blueridgeenergy.com pages (Ways to Pay, Billing Options, Manage Your Propane and Fuel Service Account) and the public myaccount.blueridgeenergy.com 'Propane & Fuels Account Login' page; no sign-in, no registration, no forms submitted. Propane & Fuels accounts are separate from the electric co-op account. Sign-in: 'Email Address or Account Number' + Password ('Login' / 'Register' tabs, 'Establish Your Online Account'). Registration: account number and the house or PO Box number (number only) from the invoice plus an email address, then Continue and set a password; the house-number field is not expressible (CROSS-OWNER REQUEST: 'houseNumber' registration field), so it is described in help. Online for propane: Make payments, Setup AutoPay, Setup E-Bill and Go Paperless, Budget Billing, View statements, Order fuel, View pricing plans. Pay by phone 800-451-5474 (same as electric), kiosks at district offices only, office locations, mail to PO Box 112, Lenoir, NC 28645-0112 with the bill stub. Move/transfer and cancel service by calling 1-800-451-5474; address changes for propane also need a call. Payment arrangements are listed for electric only, so propane arrangements are left at the family default. Card/bank fees and late charges are not published on the pages used. Review 2026-10-10: the propane portal header shows 800-726-0405, but every blueridgeenergy.com propane billing page (Ways to Pay, Billing Options, account management) uses 1-800-451-5474, so that number is kept.

guest_pay.note: Propane & Fuels payments online are made after you log in. You can also pay by phone at 800-451-5474, at a district office kiosk or by mail.

cancel_service.note: To move, transfer or cancel your propane and fuels service, call 1-800-451-5474.

help.title: Ways to pay for propane & fuels
paragraphs: Propane & Fuels accounts are billed separately from electric service. Pay online by logging in to your propane account, through the Propane & Fuels mobile app, or by phone at 800-451-5474.

You can also pay at a kiosk (district offices only), at an office, or by mail to Blue Ridge Energy, PO Box 112, Lenoir, NC 28645-0112. When paying by mail, drop box or office visit, return the bottom part of your bill with the payment.
steps: Log in with your email address or account number and password.
Enter the amount and payment method, then submit.

help.title: Establish your online account
paragraphs: On the Register tab, enter the account number and the house or PO Box number (number only) shown on your propane invoice, plus a valid email address. Choose Continue, then set your password and keep it somewhere safe.

help.title: Propane billing options
paragraphs: Propane & Fuels customers can sign up for Budget Billing to level payments, set up AutoPay, and switch to E-Bill to go paperless, all from the propane account. Pricing plans are also listed in the account. To change your mailing address, call 1-800-451-5474.

help.title: Move, transfer or cancel service
paragraphs: To move, transfer or cancel your propane and fuels service, call Blue Ridge Energy at 1-800-451-5474.

extra.intent: Using the Blue Ridge Energy website's help pages, find the PO Box number to mail a propane bill payment to. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
